name: teardown
short: A skill that builds any machine as an offline 3D simulator page you can take apart, with live readouts and an optional video.
what: Ask how a machine works and the agent builds it as one offline HTML page. The machine runs in the middle, panels around it show its numbers, a button opens the part doing the work, and the page tours itself when left alone. It can also record a video of the tour. Three examples ship with it: a V8, a Cessna and a Strandbeest.
who: Anyone curious about how engines, watches or other machines work, and teachers who want a visual. The install command targets Claude Code.
needs: Optional: ffmpeg for video and Python 3 for sound

steps.title: Install its dependencies
steps.text: Run this once, in the installed skill folder.
steps.code: npm install && npx playwright install chromium

try.label: From the README
try.text: Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

watch: The setup step downloads a Chromium browser through Playwright.
Video and sound need extra tools: ffmpeg and Python 3.
